answer: Each agent must stake a bond and solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity, then broadcast the result as a signed plume of attestations that peers verify before granting voting weight. A single sybil identity would need to replicate that costly work and bond for every fake node, so the marginal cost scales linearly with each forged identity. Any raven that attempts to spoof the signal without the underlying stake is rejected at verification, making mass identity forgery economically irrational.
